sentences.text: 1 For Petitioners : Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Sahu, Advocate For State : Mr. Prateek Tiwari, Panel Lawyer Hon'ble Shri Justice Rakesh Mohan Pandey Order on Board 04.04.2025

1 ) The petitioners have filed this petition seeking the following relief(s):-
"10.1
That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to call the records pertaining to the case from the respondent authorities.

10.2 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue an appropriate writ,
thereby directing the respondent authorities to re-initiate the acquisition process for acquisition of land of petitioners and pay fair compensation in respect of land of petitioners according to present market value of subject land, with interest @ 18%
per annum from the date of taking possession of land to its realization.
10.3
To kindly grant any other relief which may be deem fit in the given facts and circumstances of the instant case."

2) Mr. Prateek Tiwari, learned Panel Lawyer appearing for the State would submit that the petitioners have remedy to approach the authority i.e. Collector according to the provisions of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, the Act, 2013).
3) Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Sahu, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that the adequate compensation was not paid to the petitioners.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He would pray that the petitioners may be permitted to withdraw this petition with liberty to approach the concerned Collector according to the provisions of Section 64 of the Act, 2013.
4) Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

5) If the petitioners prefer a reference according to the provisions of Section 64 of the Act, 2013 before the concerned authority, it is expected that the authority concerned shall decide it strictly in accordance with law expeditiously as per the mandate of that Section.

Sd/-
(Rakesh Mohan Pandey) Judge Nadim Dikeshwar Dhruw vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 4 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110912399/
